name: Yuki* to Ri* wa Shujinkou no Koto ga Suki Datta no ni Kimodebu no Chi*po Benki ni Narimashita.
original_name: 雪●とり●は主人公の事が好きだったのにキモデブのチ●ポ便器になりました。
source:
Two heroines from Pers*na may have loved the protagonist,
but in The C*ck Objectificiation of Yuk*ko and R*se they each
succumb to the wishes of a kimo-debu.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180602121346/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106930.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
出自《女神○闻录》的两位女主角原本倾心于主人公，
然而在这部描绘雪○与理○沦为肉便器的故事中，她们却双双屈服于恶心肥宅的淫威之下。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180602121346/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106930.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
